diagnostics.message: aws_cloudfront_distribution.default has an explicit `depends_on = ["aws_s3_bucket.origin"]`, but this ordering is already implied by an ordinary attribute reference: the distribution's `origin.domain_name` uses `local.bucket_domain_name`, which resolves through `local.bucket` to `aws_s3_bucket.origin.*.id`. Terraform propagates that dependency through the local value, so the explicit depends_on is redundant (and, when `var.origin_bucket` is set so the bucket has count 0, it references zero instances and is meaningless).
